lines.en: I scoot forward on my belly.
I hump along, bit by bit.
My flippers drag on the sand.
I make for the water.
I'm warm in the sun.
Slow and clumsy on land.
A wide trail in the sand.
I stopped to rest.
In the water I'm much faster.

lines.zh: 湿毛贴着身子，走得很沉。
lines.en: Wet fur clings to me and my crawl is heavy.
I flop off the rock.
I bark as I shuffle.
I raise my head at the waves.
I head toward the others.
I follow the wet sand forward.

lines.zh: 海浪退的时候我往前一点。
lines.en: When the wave pulls back, I go a little.
I stop between two rocks.
Salt crusts on my fur.
I lie on the rock.
The sea wind dries my fur.
I can't be bothered to move.
The surf keeps striking the rocks.
I lift my head.
I'm warm from the sun.

lines.zh: 我朝水里短促地叫了两声。
lines.en: I give two short barks toward the water.
Something moves in the water.
I shut my eyes and sun my belly.
This rock is flat.
My flippers rest on the edge.
I don't feel like shifting today.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔一直抽动着嗅。
lines.en: My nostrils keep working at the air.
I settle into a better position.
You're quite dry.
I'm clumsy on land.
I must look like a rock to you.
I'm not afraid of people.
Is that a bucket?
I'm not like this in the water.
Stand back. I'm going to flop down.
My fur is wet.
Don't step on me.
I'm quite gentle like this.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子挪到湿沙上。
lines.en: I drag myself over onto the wet sand.
The skin is a little torn.
I yelped from the pain.
Some fur came out.
I rolled over.
It doesn't really hurt.
The wet fur covers the wound.

lines.zh: 疼起来我只想往浪里爬。
lines.en: When it hurts I only want to crawl to the surf.
I'm still on the rock.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我在沙上翻了个滚。
lines.en: That hit sent me rolling over the sand.

lines.zh: 那东西闻着像刚捞的鱼。
lines.en: That smells like fish just pulled out.
That's just to my taste.
Bring it here. Don't throw it.
Feed me and I'll follow.
One isn't enough; got more?

lines.zh: 搁在石头上，我爬过去拿。
lines.en: Set it on the stone and I'll crawl over.

lines.zh: 我闻得出是不是新鲜的。
lines.en: I can tell if it's fresh.
This one's a bit small.
Keep some for yourself.
No rush. I eat slowly.
You bumped me. I can't move much.
I'm all wet fur; you can't hold me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住我的前鳍。
lines.en: Your boot is pinning my front flipper.
Now we're both on the ground.
I slide half a foot along the sand.
That rolled me over.
I'm covered in sand.

lines.zh: 你退开后我慢慢翻回来。
lines.en: I righted myself after you moved.

lines.zh: 再挤，我们俩都要翻过去。
lines.en: Any closer and we'll both roll over.
I hardly ever get cross.
This is done in the water.
We lean together on the shore.
Don't stand so close.
It's bigger than me.

lines.zh: 北边那块礁上还有几只。
lines.en: There are a few more on that reef.

lines.zh: 我吃完鱼才会有这心思。
lines.en: I only feel this way after fish.
The water keeps sounding.
Afterwards we go into the water together.
We polished the stone.
I didn't make a sound.
I pick up a fish.
It's too slick to hold.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它拱了个圈。
lines.en: I nudge it around in a circle with my nose.

lines.zh: 它顺着喉咙滑下去，没了。
lines.en: It slides down my throat and is gone.
There's a shell on the ground.
I flicked it with a flipper.
That's not fish; I turn my head away.
It rolled to the water's edge.
I pick it up and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 腮帮子鼓起来，我嚼不动。
lines.en: My cheeks bulge; I can't chew it all.
You stepped on my rock.

lines.zh: 礁石一震，我就知道有人。
lines.en: The rock shook; I know someone's here.
I'm rolling over slowly.
I'm not much of a fighter.
One more step and I'm in the water.
I'm shuffling toward the water.
In the water I'm faster than you.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我看到了。
lines.en: I see what's in your hands.
There's only rock and sea here.
You're blocking my way to the water.
My eyes haven't left you.
You're between me and the surf.
I stay put and wait for you to move first.
I've rolled upright.
You've ducked behind the far side of the rock.
I'm going into the water.
You're at the water's edge.
I cried out in pain.
The others all raised their heads.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙一点点朝你蹭。
lines.en: Belly to the sand, I inch toward you.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子横着推出去。
lines.en: I throw my whole body sideways into you.

lines.zh: 我没什么力气，可牙还在。
lines.en: I have little strength, but I still have teeth.
You were pushed aside.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，再拧半圈。
lines.en: I bite down and twist half a turn.
A flipper slapped your leg.
I toppled onto the ground.
I got up only after you moved.
I'm rolling in sand and itching all over.
That was my best.
It made quite a noise.

lines.zh: 浪把我推上礁石，我趴稳。
lines.en: A wave shoves me onto the rock and I settle.

lines.zh: 水从我的胡须上一直滴。
lines.en: Water keeps dripping from my whiskers.
I pant on the stone.
This shore is flat.
I call toward the others.
A wave nudged me.

lines.zh: 我把肚皮贴在石头上喘。
lines.en: I press my belly to the stone and pant.
My trail is in the sand.
Plenty of fish in this water.
I shuffle up to the dry ground.
I tumble out of the surf.

lines.zh: 一上岸我就抖开浑身的毛。
lines.en: Once ashore I shake the water out of my fur.
Fire caught me; the fur singed.
I hit the ground with a slap.

lines.zh: 我该会游的，可水太深了。
lines.en: I should be able to swim. Too deep.
The blast threw me into the sand.
An arrow stuck in me. It hurts.
That light is brighter than any I know.
No fish, no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I went stiff.
No water in the void.
